entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, he even figured out when we're[n]gonna do it!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is different from normal.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He has some nerve, delivering the calling[n]card to the police himself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Either he's certain his heart won't be[n]changed, or he's colluded with the police[n]from the beginning...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: As strange as it is for me to say... I could[n]see that being the case.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa, the comments're coming in hot![n]Look!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: "Take him down, Phantom Thieves!"

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: "I don't care what the Phantom Thieves[n]do as long as they show up haha."[n]"Just do it quick lol."

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: They're just saying whatever they want.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At this point all they care about is seeing[n]those in power beg for forgiveness.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Dammit! This isn't a game!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The means and the ends have been[n]reversed. We're starting to be seen[n]purely as entertainment...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But we gotta do this! We can't just drop[n]everything now!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Considering the existence of the Palace,[n]his desires are indeed distorted...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In a sense, the earlier we pull the root,[n]the better...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And given the issue concerning Haru's[n]fiancé, we don't have another choice in[n]the matter...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If we don't... then everything we been[n]doin' up until now would just be for[n]nothing!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I believe this is best too. After hearing[n]my father speak... I saw no remorse[n]in him.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji and Haru are right.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Honestly, everything the public is talking[n]about does bother me a little...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But Okumura may just be the one behind[n]the mental collapses. We can't leave[n]this be.
We most definitely can't.
I want to know the truth.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I feel like he's hiding something.[n]Something big...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: True... And we already sent the calling[n]card, after all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's do this like we always do...[n]and steal his Palace's Treasure.
